The  Recognition  and  Enforcement  of  International  Settlement  Agreements
10
“High Court” means the High Court established for the
Province by Article 154p of the Constitution and exercising
civil  jurisdiction  under  the  High  Court  of  the  Provinces
“mediation”  means  a  process,  irrespective  of  the
expression used to the basis upon which the process is carried
out, whereby parties attempt to reach an amicable settlement
of their dispute with the assistance of one or more third parties
(“the mediator”) lacking the authority to impose a solution
upon the parties to the dispute;
“parties” means the parties to the international settlement
agreement in relation to the mediation, and does not include
the mediator or mediators conducting the mediation;
